items.title: Show HN: Tracking spec-driven development in the wild
items.desc: An open directory tracking spec-driven development frameworks and real-world projects over time, to evaluate how effective different approaches are in practice.
items.author: emilesilvis
items.descZh: 这是一份追踪"规范驱动开发"(spec-driven development)框架与实际项目的开放目录，旨在横向评估不同方法论在实践中的有效性。该项目试图通过收集真实使用案例，帮助开发者和团队判断哪种规范驱动框架最适合其工作流程。其核心亮点在于以"目录化+时间维度"的方式沉淀开源生态中的实践样本，类似 Spec-Kit、OpenSpec 等工具的落地参考库。适用场景包括企业架构师评估开发规范、团队选型决策以及 AI 编程助手(Agent / Vibe Coding)时代的工程方法论研究。
items.quote: 一个开放的目录，用于追踪由规范驱动开发（spec-driven development）框架以及真实项目随时间的演进情况，旨在评估不同方法在实践中的实际效果。
items.titleZh: Show HN：追踪真实场景中的规范驱动开发

items.author: MikeLuLu
items.descZh: 背景：作者开发ScriptSpool的初衷是为了给自己的开发教程制作简短的代码动画，现有的类似工具要么功能有限，要么像专业视频编辑器一样过于复杂。核心功能：ScriptSpool是一款轻量级代码动画生成工具，专注于简化代码演示动画的制作流程。亮点：针对开发教程场景进行了轻量化设计，避免了完整视频编辑器的繁琐操作，同时弥补了现有工具功能不足的痛点。适用场景：特别适合需要为代码讲解、技术教程录制添加代码动画效果的开发者和教育者。原文中体现产品定位的最具代表性英文原句为"So I decided"——完整文章内容被截断，但可推断作者决定自行开发该工具。

Repository files navigation KVeritas Go Tamperevident verification for computational experiments. It binds a published result to the exact code, hardware, and time that produced it, in a cryptographically signed PDF anyone can verify. Works with any language, zero runtime dependencies, single static binary. Platform. Verify, seal, proofs, checkout, benchmark artifacts, provenance, and disclosure levels are crossplatform. The file/subprocess activity map and perprocess hardware attribution are Linuxonly today; elsewhere they fall back to systemwide readings. Install Prebuilt binary: curl fsSL https://github.com/27GROUP/kveritasreleases/raw/main/bin/kveritaslinuxamd64 o kveritas chmod +x kveritas && sudo mv kveritas /usr/local/bin/ Binaries: kveritas{linux,darwin,windows}{amd64,arm64}. Or build from source (Go 1.22+): make build. Quick start kveritas init start a session (redacted by default) kveritas run python train.py epochs 90 run under kveritas (any command) kveritas run python evaluate.py kveritas seal output report.pdf signed PDF (+ bundle at disclosure open) kveritas verify report.pdf verify (add offline to skip the server) Protocol lines Print these to stdout in any language; everything captured is bound into the signed record. Line Purpose KVERITAS\_METRIC name=<id value=<float \[step=<label\] Record a metric. KVERITAS\_PHASE name=<phase Mark a phase boundary (hardware snapshot). KVERITAS\_CLAIM metric=<id value=<float Commit a headline claim. KVERITAS\_INPUT src=seed:<value Commit a random seed. KVERITAS\_MODEL params=<int arch=<name precision=<fp16\bf16fp32 Model card (feeds computecost). KVERITAS\_WORKLOAD dataset\_size=<int epochs=<float batch\_size=<int \[seq\_len=<int\] Workload card. KVERITAS\_ARTIFACT role=model\dataset \[name=<ref\] path=<file visibility=publicprivate Attest a model or dataset. Common metrics are also autodetected (Keras history, sklearn CV, metriclike locals), so simple runs need no lines. HMCA (execution coherence) Metricblind. It never looks at the reported result. During the run a background sampler records perprocess telemetry (CPU, memory, context switches, page faults, CPU frequency, I/O, and, when a GPU is used, its utilization, memory, power, temperature) at about 10 Hz. At seal time HMCA scores whether those channels cofluctuate as shadows of one process: a genuine run drives them all from one activity, a fabricated or replayed trace does not. Verdict is PASS (coherent), WARN, FAIL (incoherent), or N/A (too little telemetry to judge). A light run is judged on the activity it has, never penalized for being light. The web verifier renders the channels over time. Computecost attestation When a run declares a model card, seal produces a certificate checking the declared FLOPs against what the hardware could physically
items.author: Mkld27
items.descZh:
KVeritas 是一款面向计算实验的"防篡改验证"命令行工具，旨在解决科研与机器学习领域中"结果可复现但难以验证真伪"的痛点。它通过将实验结果与产生该结果的代码、硬件环境及时间戳以加密签名 PDF 的方式绑定，任何第三方均可独立验证，从而提供超越传统可复现性的可信度证明。

核心功能围绕 init、run、seal、verify 四个子命令展开，用户可通过 `KVERITAS_*` 协议行（涵盖 METRIC、PHASE、CLAIM、INPUT、MODEL、WORKLOAD、ARTIFACT 等）在任意代码中插入标记，并兼容 Keras、sklearn 等框架的自动指标捕获；同时支持 `benchmark`、`checkout`、`proofs`、`disclosure` 等子模块。该工具以单一静态二进制分发，零运行时依赖，并支持 Linux、macOS 与 Windows 跨平台运行（其中文件/子进程活动映射与逐进程硬件归因仅限 Linux，其他平台回退至系统级读取）。

亮点是名为 HMCA（执行一致性）的指标无关检测机制：后台采样器以约 10 Hz 记录每进程的 CPU、内存、上下文切换、页面错误、I/O 等遥测数据，并在使用 GPU 时额外捕获其利用率、显存、功耗与温度；签名时评分各通道是否同源波动，从而区分真实运行与伪造/回放轨迹，输出 PASS / WARN / FAIL / N/A 四级判定。此外，结合模型卡声明，seal 阶段会生成 FLOPs 与硬件物理能力的"算力证明"证书。

适用场景包括机器学习论文投稿附带的可验证附录、第三方基准测试的独立审计、训练成本核算（如 GPU 小时数与 FLOPs 校验），以及任何需要向审稿人、合作伙伴或监管方证明"实验确实发生过"的科研与工业场景。
items.quote: 适用于计算实验的可篡改验证。它将已发布的结果与其生成时所使用的精确代码、硬件和时间通过密码学方式绑定在一起。
items.titleZh: 展示HN：证明你的代码产生了你的声明，而不会让评审者怀疑它。

items.author: thedreammachine
items.descZh: Preseason 是一个开源基准测试项目，旨在衡量当开发者向大语言模型询问构建真实 Web 应用时，LLM 会推荐哪些开发工具。该项目由 betocmn 维护，目前在 GitHub 上获得 3 个 Star 和 717 次提交，处于早期但持续迭代的阶段。从仓库结构来看，项目使用 Next.js 构建，结合 Drizzle ORM 与 Supabase 作为数据层，并通过 promptfoo 框架（配置文件如 `promptfooconfig.majortools.yaml`）实现基准评测逻辑。其核心功能是模拟真实建站场景，向 LLM 提出工具选型问题，再统计模型推荐结果的分布与倾向，以此评估各开发工具在 AI 生态中的"曝光度"和心智占有率。该基准填补了"工具是否被 LLM 推荐"这一新兴度量空白，对希望优化 LLM 可见性的工具厂商、研究模型偏好偏差的学者以及关注 AI 编程工作流变化的开发者都具有参考价值。不过由于 Star 数仅 3、社区影响力尚浅，数据的行业公信力仍需时间积累。
items.quote: 一个开源基准测试，用于衡量在被要求构建真实 Web 应用时，大语言模型（LLM）会推荐哪些开发工具。

Recommender Query Language (RecQL) image: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/321808070?s=280&v=4 title: Recommender Query Language (RecQL) <DOCTYPE html [Skip to content](startofcontent) You signed in with another tab or window. [README.md](/recql/.github/tree/main/profile/README.md) Replace your entire recommendation pipeline with one query. RecQL is a databaseagnostic query language for recommendations, personalization, and ranked retrieval. It gives you one way to express candidate retrieval, filtering, scoring, ranking, and reordering, without wiring your application logic to a specific database or search engine. It even allows you to mixandmatch data across systems. SELECT score(expression='0.5 retrieval.get_score("semantic", 0) + 0.3 retrieval.get_score("lexical", 0) + 0.2 retrieval.get_score("user_taste", 0)') AS s, diversity(score=s, strength=0.3) AS ranked, FROM retrieve( text_search(query=$query, mode='vector', text_embedding_ref='content_embedding', limit=100, name='semantic'), text_search(query=$query, mode='lexical', limit=100, name='lexical'), similarity(embedding_ref='als', encoder=precomputed_user(input_user_id=$user_id), limit=100, name='user_taste') ) WHERE in_stock = true ORDER BY ranked LIMIT 20 One query hybrid retrieval, model scoring, and diversity reranking that runs against your database of choice. No new pipeline to build. No new infrastructure. No rewrite when you switch backends. The Problem Recommendation systems increasingly depend on data spread across operational databases, warehouses, and analytical systems. Each one exposes search and ranking differently: SQL filters and ordering Fulltext and lexical search Vector similarity and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search Databasespecific scoring and ranking functions So teams end up rebuilding the same retrieval pipeline by hand for every backend they touch hundreds of lines of glue code and logic to express what is, at heart, a single query. How RecQL Solves It RecQL defines a portable retrieval and ranking model that compiles to the native fulltext and vector search capabilities of your database. A single RecQL query expresses a full fourstage recommendation pipeline: Retrieve → Filter → Score → Reorder and combines multiple retrieval strategies, including: Structured queries Lexical search Vector similarity Popularity and trending Modelgenerated scores Hybrid and rankfusion retrieval Database adapters translate RecQL into the appropriate SQL, query API, or native search primitives so the same query runs on Postgres today and Snowflake tomorrow, without a rewrite. What You Can Build Every one of these is the same fourstage query retrieve → filter → score → reorder \ with different pieces swapped in. No new service per use case. No new database. A personalized "For You" feed: SELECT score(model='click_through_rate', input_user_id=$user_id) AS s, diversity(score=s, strength=0.3) AS feed, FROM retrieve( similarity(embedding_ref='als', encoder=interaction_pooling(input_user_id=$user_id), limit=200) ) ORDER BY feed LIMIT 20 Hybrid search (lexical + semantic, fused): SELECT score(expression='0.5 retrieval.get_score("semantic", 0) + 0.5 retrieval.get_score("lexical", 0)') AS s, FROM retrieve( text_search(query=$query, mode='vector', text_embedding_ref='content_embedding', limit=100, name='semantic'), text_search(query=$query, mode='lexical', limit=100, name='lexical') ) ORDER BY s LIMIT 20 Reranking an external candidate set with diversity: SELECT score(model='click_through_rate', input_user_id=$user_id) AS s, diversity(score=s, strength=0.4) AS r, FROM retrieve(candidate_ids($candidate_ids)) ORDER BY r LIMIT 10 Every example below runs live in the [playground](https://github.com/recql/recqlplayground/tree/main/examples) against MovieLens. items.author: jonahharris
items.descZh: RecQL 由 @nextgres 团队推出，是一种与数据库无关的可移植查询语言，旨在用一条查询替代整条推荐流水线。其核心功能是把候选召回、过滤、打分、重排序四个阶段统一在一种语法中表达，并支持跨系统混合数据源，编译为目标数据库（Postgres、Snowflake 等）的原生全文与向量搜索能力。亮点在于用一段 SQL 同时融合语义、词义和用户偏好三种召回（如 0.5/0.3/0.2 权重融合分数），并通过 diversity() 函数实现多样性重排，无需新增基础设施或重写逻辑即可切换后端。适用场景涵盖相似物品/用户推荐、混合搜索、个性化"For You"流、热门与趋势信息流以及业务规则提升等，可直接在 MovieLens 数据的 Playground 中运行示例。
items.quote: 用一条查询替换你整个推荐管线。
items.titleZh: RecQL -一种用于搜索和推荐的可移植查询语言
